[EN] Rage against the Ragers
[ES] Rabia contra los ragers
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I want Kaidun's troops to suffer. Get after them!
[ES] ¡Quiero que las tropas de Kaidun sufran. Ve tras ellos!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Imagine how furious Kaidun must be!
[ES] ¡Imagina lo furioso que debe estar Kaidun!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Sihran Army Insignia
[ES] Insignia del ejército Sihran
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Follow the southern road to the Winterwolves Encampment. Eliminate tuwangi thumpers and Sihran ragers, and collect their insignia.
[ES] Sigue el camino hacia el sur hasta el campamento de los Winterwolves. Elimina a los percussionistas tuwangi y a los ragers Sihran, y recoge sus insignias.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the insignia to Qale.
[ES] Entrega las insignias a Qale.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad to do my duty!"
[ES] "¡Un placer cumplir con mi deber!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
